cards.speaker: James
cards.text: {faction} are about to feel crowded by us. I'd rather settle that before it's a grievance. Favours, a gift, a fair deal, and the next call is a conversation.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: There's a clash coming with {faction}. We both want the same ground. Get on their good side now and it stays a disagreement.

cards.speaker: James
cards.text: {faction} will move on us sooner or later, and it'll cost more than a courtesy does. Buy the courtesy. This fortnight.
